label: Some two distinct beings each move the other while each is being moved
paraphrase: OPEN analyst observation premise, attribution deferred, under a physical instantiation of MOTION_1: there are distinct a and b and respects r and s such that a moves b in r, b moves a in s, a is being moved in s and b is being moved in r. Example: a hot iron laid on cooler wood heats the wood while the wood cools the iron. Physics III.2 202a3-7 says that a mover which is itself movable acts by contact and is at the same time acted upon (navigation for the reciprocity, not a claim). With the strong per se premise 1e47e6db-da06-5a40-9ccf-fbd1f929c596 and the regress premise 226c38f6-7bf4-552a-9a85-733cfa41d0fa it is jointly inconsistent: the registered derivation from those two premises concludes its negation. It is consistent with the relevant-respect premise 96da1d33-7a73-567e-9557-ba4a9a4bb798 and the regress when neither party's being moved is relevant, as on the lending reading, where reaction from the patient is not lending (scratch control 4 of the note, not registered).
